verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS on its own platform. HIPAA has a framework page, a control mapping to Unified Controls, and a breach notification template; GDPR is added through its multi-framework approach; PCI DSS comes with ASV scans and pentesting. All frameworks map to a single unified control list, so adding a framework reuses existing work instead of needing a new tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, and GDPR evidence beyond marketing pages (no help-center GDPR control mapping like the ones for HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST).
